name: FinMatch
purpose: Gamified watchlist discovery over a bundled SSE-style sample universe: a seven-question behavioural match selects a company-size pool, industry picks narrow it, a transparent value screen (positive P/E at or below a ceiling and dividend yield at or above a floor) filters it with the platform's screening contract, and the surviving companies are dealt as swipe cards to keep or fold.
inputs: Seven behavioural questionnaire answers (low / medium / high each)
Industry selection across the five bundled industries (none means all)
Maximum P/E and minimum dividend yield for the value screen

outputDetails.Value screen outcome: Live counts of universe companies passing the screen, excluded for missing numbers, and remaining in the size-and-industry pool, computed with the same rules as the verified screening calculation; missing P/E or yield excludes rather than defaulting to zero.
outputDetails.Dealt company cards: Up to five cards per round in random order, each showing name, ticker, industry, size, market cap and the chosen metrics with industry fixture medians; every metric value is a deterministic local fixture and is labelled as one.
outputDetails.Session watchlist: Kept companies with their selected metrics. The sandboxed preview has no durable storage of its own, so keeps live for the session and the interface says so; shared platform storage is used automatically when the platform grants capability access.
outputDetails.Metric chooser with education: Toggles for which of the six fixture metrics (P/E, P/S, dividend yield, revenue growth, ROE, interest coverage) appear on cards and in the watchlist, plus a plain-language guide to each metric's meaning, basis and comparison limits.

constraints: Every metric value is a labelled deterministic fixture, never presented as a market observation
Random card order is not a financial ranking and the risk band never claims investment suitability
Missing fundamentals exclude a company from the screen and are shown as unavailable, never as zero
Self-contained in the platform sandbox; no network, imports or embedded credentials
